content.short: MC² Finance is a decentralized wealth management protocol enabling institutional and retail users to access standardized token investment strategies on Mantle.
content.description: MC² Finance is a decentralized asset management protocol standardizing crypto investment strategies and making them accessible to all investors through transparent on-chain portfolios. Expert investors publish their strategies as trackable on-chain portfolios while retail users allocate funds to follow them with full transparency. MC² Finance brings hedge fund-style portfolio management to DeFi on Mantle, democratizing access to sophisticated investment approaches without custodial risk.
content.meta: MC² Finance provides decentralized wealth management and standardized token strategies on Mantle. Discover MC² Finance on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
